name: Sakashita Harumi
source:
1st year high school student.
A friend of the protagonist's younger brother.
A small boy who gives off the sense of a small animal.
He has no supernatural powers of his own but he is really in love with the occult.
He also loves the fortunes that the protagonist gives.
